info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Retail Orders Tracks-v5-spec
info.description: The Retail Order Tracking API provides an interface for retrieving tracking information of retail orders. This service enables businesses to monitor the status and movement of their placed orders in real time. Typical consumers include retail managers, customer service representatives, and fulfillment teams who need to provide updates to customers regarding their order status. By integrating this API, organizations can enhance customer satisfaction through timely and accurate order information.

get.summary: Track the status of an order.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the current status and tracking information for their orders. It provides real-time updates about shipping and delivery, ensuring users can easily keep track of their purchased items.

requestBody.description: The request body for tracking an order. This JSON object should contain the necessary parameters to identify and retrieve the order tracking information.

200.description: Successfully retrieved tracking information for the order.
